description: pkix-revocation/src/ocsp.rs:399-420 (verify_responder_id) and 427-447 (verify_responder_id_anchor) share identical match logic. The only difference is how the issuer's name and SPKI key are accessed: Certificate vs TrustAnchor. Idiomatic Rust: extract the common logic into a fn verify_responder_id_inner(id: &ResponderId, issuer_name: &Name, issuer_key_raw: &[u8]) -> crate::Result<()> and call it from both wrappers, eliminating the duplicate match arms.
title: ocsp.rs: verify_responder_id and verify_responder_id_anchor duplicated
